detail.longDescription: Gapfill now sells AI prompt packs alongside the WordPress plugins. Five packs written for specific trades: real estate, fitness training, business consulting, beauty and home services. Each has 55 fill-in-the-blank prompts (fill in the [BRACKETED] parts, paste into ChatGPT, Claude or Gemini) as a document plus a searchable spreadsheet. $29 each, $97 for all five, or $149 for every plugin and pack. https:// gapfill-plugins.vercel.app/api /s?mastodon-prompts-launch # AI # ChatGPT # SmallBusiness
